news.headline: TCG Crossover and Chen Yu Report 7.0% Stake in Abivax After the July Offering
news.summary: Healthcare crossover investor TCG Crossover (Funds I and II, via managing partner Chen Yu) disclosed beneficial ownership of 6,007,834 ADSs, or 7.0% of Abivax, based on 86.09 million shares outstanding after the July 2, 2026 offering. Together with an Invus 13G/A a day earlier showing 4,825,759 shares (6.0%), it confirms that the specialist register held through the large equity raise rather than selling into strength.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: The FDA gave constructive feedback and aligned with Abivax on the planned submission strategy, content and format of the obefazimod NDA in moderately-to-severely active ulcerative colitis. Abivax confirmed it remains on track to file its first-ever NDA by the end of 2026, removing a key procedural uncertainty.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $180 from $132, Maintains Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its target well above the prevailing share price, citing growing confidence in the obefazimod UC data package and the NDA timeline after the 44-week maintenance results and pre-NDA FDA feedback. It followed a June 30 Jefferies upgrade to Buy (target raised to $158 from $108) once malignancy rates were shown to be in line with background UC rates; consensus targets now cluster around $155-166.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax hired four senior commercial executives covering marketing, patient services, sales and commercial operations, and market access to build a standalone U.S. commercial organization ahead of a potential obefazimod launch. The move signals the company is preparing to launch on its own rather than depending on a partner or acquirer.

news.headline: Biotech Abivax Re-Engages Investment Bank Centerview for Big Pharma Takeover Talks - La Lettre
news.summary: French outlet La Lettre reported that Abivax brought Centerview back as M&A adviser amid renewed large-pharma interest, only two weeks after closing the $920 million raise that management framed as removing the need to sell. The same outlet had earlier reported Eli Lilly weighing a roughly EUR 15 billion ($17.5bn) approach; Abivax has not confirmed any process and previously denied a separate AstraZeneca report in March 2026.

news.headline: Abivax $920 Million Cash Haul Lets It Prepare for Solo U.S. Launch Instead of Relying on a Buyer, CEO Tells CNBC
news.summary: CEO Marc de Garidel said the upsized $920 million raise (closed July 6, ~$874 million net, priced at $125 per ADS) funds Abivax into Q4 2029 and lets it build U.S. launch infrastructure itself rather than accept a takeover. He did not rule out a deal but framed the raise as removing pressure to sell, against persistent buyout chatter that some analysts have modelled at up to $23 billion.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists first-half 2026 results for September 21, 2026. The update should refresh the post-raise cash position (guided into Q4 2029 versus EUR 491.6m and a Q4 2027 runway at March 31, 2026), R&D spend, NDA-preparation progress and the U.S. pre-launch commercial build-out.

catalysts.label: Full ABTECT maintenance dataset at a major medical congress
catalysts.detail: Abivax said it would submit the detailed 44-week maintenance dataset for presentation at an upcoming medical meeting; UEG Week 2026 in October is the natural venue after the company presented ABTECT induction late-breakers at UEG 2025. Detailed efficacy-by-subgroup and the expanded safety database (including the malignancy question that hit the stock in June) are what the market will scrutinise. Not yet announced by the company.

catalysts.label: NDA submission to FDA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: After positive Phase 3 ABTECT induction and 44-week maintenance data (Week 44 clinical remission 50.8% at 25mg and 51.3% at 50mg vs 10.4% placebo) and the constructive pre-NDA meeting on July 30, 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first NDA in moderately-to-severely active UC in late Q4 2026. This is the single biggest near-term de-risking event and the gate that starts the FDA review clock.

catalysts.label: MAA submission to the EMA for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Abivax has guided to filing a Marketing Authorization Application in Europe in the second half of 2026, contingent on the (now positive) maintenance data. Recent communications emphasise the Q4 2026 FDA filing and have not restated a precise EMA date, so exact MAA timing remains unconfirmed.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax's financial calendar lists third-quarter 2026 results for December 14, 2026. Coming right around the targeted NDA filing, it is the likely venue for confirming that the submission has been made and for first colour on launch spending.

catalysts.label: Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD Crohn's disease 12-week induction topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline results from the Phase 2b induction trial of obefazimod in moderately-to-severely active Crohn's disease are guided for mid-2027 (enrollment started Q3 2024). A positive readout opens a second large indication for the miR-124 mechanism, but it likely lands near or just after the March-2027 option expiry.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval decision on the obefazimod NDA
catalysts.detail: With a Q4 2026 filing and a standard review cycle, an FDA decision would fall roughly 10-12 months later, i.e. in H2 2027 - after the March-2027 call expiry. No PDUFA date exists yet because the NDA has not been submitted; this remains the ultimate approval and launch catalyst for the equity.

pulse: Abivax is in a quiet, execution-only phase: the last company press release was the July 30 pre-NDA announcement confirming FDA alignment on an end-2026 NDA filing, and August newsflow has been limited to 13G/A filings showing TCG Crossover at 7.0% and Invus at 6.0% - i.e. specialist holders sitting tight after the $920m July raise that funds a solo U.S. launch into Q4 2029. The science looks largely settled (positive ABTECT induction, 44-week maintenance with ~51% clinical remission, and Part 2 data showing benefit in refractory and relapsed patients), so the next real tests are the September 21 H1 report, a likely October congress presentation of the full maintenance dataset, and the Q4 2026 NDA submission itself. Main risks for a March-2027 call sitting near the strike: the filing slipping past year-end, the malignancy/safety debate resurfacing when the detailed dataset is presented, and the fact that the FDA decision and the mid-2027 Crohn's readout both fall after expiry - leaving the position dependent on sentiment, sell-side targets around $155-166, and unconfirmed takeover chatter (Centerview re-engaged per La Lettre in July) rather than a hard binary event.
